gizmo.title: I-crossword
gizmo.description: I-crossword eyenziwe ohlwini lwamagama nemikhondo. Igridi ikhiqizwa wena; abafundi bathayipha amagama bese bewahlola.

configure.title: Isihloko
configure.description: Isihloko noma umbuzo oboniswa ngaphezu kwe-crossword.

configure.title: Amagama
configure.description: Igama ngalinye nomkhondo walo. Igridi ikhiqizwa kulolu hlu: igama elide kakhulu libekwa kuqala bese amanye eliwela ezinhlamvwini abelana ngazo.

advanced.title: Imizamo
advanced.description: Izikhathi umfundi angahlola ngazo. U-0 usho ukuthi akunamkhawulo.

advanced.title: Umbala wokugcizelela
advanced.description: Umbala ongakhethwa we-chip yesihloko, igama elisebenzayo nezinkinobho zezenzo.

advanced.title: Iyagoqeka
advanced.description: Bonisa le crossword njengomugqa ovuleka futhi uvaleke. Ukuvula owodwa kuvala eminye imibuzo egoqekayo eseduze nawo.

advanced.title: Qala kugoqiwe
advanced.description: Uma igoqeka, qala njengomugqa ovaliwe obonisa isihloko nesimo sawo kuphela.

advanced.title: Ifomethi yokumaka
advanced.description: OER Schema: ifomethi yokumaka yalokhu kuhlola (isb. amaphuzu, uhlamvu, amaphesenti, ukuqedwa).

advanced.title: Inhloso yokufunda
advanced.description: OER Schema: inhloso yokufunda ehlobene nalokhu kuhlola.

developer.title: Igama lequizi
developer.description: Igama lequizi elisetshenziselwa ukuhlonza kwe-xAPI ezinhlelweni zokuhlaziya.

developer.title: Isifundo
developer.description: OER Schema: isifundo lokhu kuhlola okuhloselwe sona.
